messages:
Ravi: Quick flag : customers hitting unpredictable costs when server-side splitting creates many small subrequests. We should expose an advisory "embed_units_estimate" early so SDKs can make informed tradeoffs.
Nora: Agree. Current 413s are a black box. Idea: a cheap pre-parse that returns a header X-Embed-Units-Estimate and an optional JSON body with suggested ranges if split-safe. Keep it advisory by default.
Diego: Implementation constraints: estimator must run before full JSON parsing to avoid OOMs. Use Content-Length + dims header + peek-first-vector to estimate bytes/vector. If dims not present, return estimate with explainability: ["dims_unknown"].
Lena: Console needs: per-tenant "Estimate vs Actual" chart, and a toggle to show sample split plans for recent advisory responses. Also expose tenant-level flag "server_split_behavior" with values: advisory, soft_enforce, strict_reject.
Ravi: Telemetry events: embed_estimate.issued, embed_split.auto_applied, embed_split.client_split. Add tags: tenant_id, sdk_name, dims_hint, estimate_units, actual_units.
Nora: Quotas: define "embed_units" = ceil((vectors * dims) / 1024) as neutral baseline. Make quota checks conservative (use estimate when advisory) so we don't undercharge. Billing uses actuals. Product to confirm naming.
Diego: Backoff guidance for SDKs: if backpressure > 75 (server-side metric) then exponential backoff with jitter and call preview endpoint before retrying. We can return X-Embed-Backpressure header (0-100) in estimate responses.
Lena: UX note: when the server offers suggested split plan, Console preview card should show an inline diff of cost and latency: client-split vs server-split. Also include a copyable bash snippet to run the splits.
Ravi: Edge case: mixed dims in a single payload. Estimator should detect mixed dims on peek and respond with 422 + explainability:["mixed_dims"] and a sample client split recommendation.
Nora: Rollout plan: feature flag advisory globally for 72h, collect metrics, then enable soft_enforce for 5% traffic. Console opt-in for tenants to see advisory responses.
Diego: Logs from local canary: 
```
2026-03-22T12:11:02Z embed_estimate: tenant=orion dims_hint=1024 vectors=4200 est_units=4200 backpressure=32 cache=miss
2026-03-22T12:11:02Z embed_split: auto_applied tenant=orion subreqs=3 latency_ms=120 success
```
Lena: Security reminder: estimate endpoints must not persist vector payloads and must sanitize any sampled bytes. Telemetry should only include aggregates.
Ravi: Ops: create alert to page if advisory_apply_rate > 1% over 10m or if backpressure_avg > 80 for 5m.
OpsBot: Alert created: advisory_apply_rate > 1% over 10m on /v1/embeddings -> paging eng-sre. Alert created: embed_backpressure_avg > 80 over 5m -> paging eng-sre.
Nora: SDK changes: Node and Python should check X-Embed-Units-Estimate and prefer client-side split if estimate > client_threshold. We'll also add a quick-opt header X-Embed-Accept-Server-Split for tenants that want server to split automatically.
Diego: I'll draft a lightweight estimator PR and a microcache keyed by (tenant, dims_hint, avg_bytes) TTL 5m. Keep CPU path fast and avoid allocations.
Lena: I'll wire Console card and a migration note in Pricing page explaining billing vs estimate semantics.
Ravi: Next steps: Diego prototypes, Nora updates SDKs, Lena builds Console mock, ops will run canary playbook in runbook. Sync tomorrow in eng-platform standup. :white_check_mark:
